product_launches.description: Chai Discovery launched Chai-2, an AI-powered platform that achieves fully de novo antibody design, significantly improving hit rates and accelerating therapeutic development timelines.

overview_description.description: Chai Discovery develops artificial intelligence models and software for protein engineering and molecular design. Its platform enables researchers to design antibodies, miniproteins, and other biomolecules from target structures or sequences while supporting different antibody formats, framework sequences, epitope selection, and molecular design criteria. The company’s technology is used to predict molecular interactions, generate de novo protein designs, and support therapeutic research by reducing experimental screening and accelerating candidate evaluation. Chai Discovery also provides controlled access to its AI models for commercial and academic research through a web-based platform.

product.name: Chai Discovery Platform
product.description: An AI-powered molecular design platform for predicting biochemical structures and interactions and designing new molecules for drug discovery programs.

product.name: Chai-2
product.description: A generative AI model series for de novo antibody design, including full-length monoclonal and VHH antibodies with specified targets, epitopes, formats, and design criteria.

product.name: Chai-3
product.description: Chai Discovery’s advanced AI model for molecular and biologics discovery, made available to pharmaceutical scientists through platform licensing and custom software arrangements.

product.name: Chai-1
product.description: A multimodal foundation model for molecular structure prediction and biochemical interaction analysis across drug discovery tasks.

product.name: Miniprotein Design Suite
product.description: A computational design suite for creating miniproteins for early biologics discovery and evaluating potential therapeutic designs.
